_about: SSO string Performance patches: how far a change to one note of a slurred phrase moves the other notes' levels. tools/soundlibraries/perturbation_scan.py (its header has the method and result). Measured 2026-10-13 on the Windows test VM: kthost (offline VST 3 host), Kontakt 8 + SSO, each patch from MuseScore's resaved setup (library defaults), 44.1 kHz. levels: per section / base / version / take, the swell level (perceived loudness, tools/playbackverify/loudness.py, ~dB, mean over 136.4 ms from the note-on + the map's legatoDelay) of notes 0-16 (0, the attack: null). table: |delta| of note k + d (version - B, same take: single; 3-take means: mean) and the noise floor (B' - B: noise1, noiseM), p50 / p90, per section and all. far: per base, the mean delta over slurs 3-4 (notes 9-16) after a change at k = 2, take means. Measurement only: the renderer does not read this file.
